correctness.rationale: The assigned proof directly computes Fourier window response i a ω/(a+iω)^2 and squared modulus (1/4)sech²(log|ω/a|). Plancherel gives the periodized positive frame multiplier P_h(t)+P_h(t-θh). Its strict centered periodic unimodality follows analytically from the Jacobi dn² Fourier identity (DLMF 22.11.13), not a numerical grid. For θ=1/2, two banks form the h/2 lattice; evaluating at the longer-gap midpoint and grid center proves every other θ has a smaller sharp lower bound and larger sharp upper bound. Nearest sech tails and the first Poisson Fourier coefficient yield the stated sparse/dense asymptotic constants. Independent mpmath verified Poisson-vs-direct sums for three scales; full parameter theorem is analytic.
